status: conditional; do not create a provider or controller from this packet
scope: exactly one future direct on/off comparison after the existing H100 owner has a healthy, reusable endpoint or its successor explicitly retains the same model/runtime/workload controller lineage

identities.workload_source: raw, deterministic repeated-prompt bytes generated from PREFIX_WORKLOAD.json labels; capture the submitted bytes, token IDs, and SHA-256s at the server boundary

ordering: For each arm use the identical raw trace. Submit each group’s warming request to successful completion before its dependent repeated-prefix requests; retain the recorded closed/open-loop arrival semantics. Alternate full arm order across repetitions or use paired repetitions.
required_raw_outputs: request/response timestamps and success/failure per request
submitted prompt bytes, tokenizer token IDs, token counts, and content hashes
vLLM cache log/metric snapshots that expose cached or computed prompt tokens and KV cache usage
GPU memory/peak allocation, prefix-cache eviction/preemption indicators, queue time, and non-overlapping prefill/decode/endpoint timing
identical deterministic output token IDs or explicit mismatch classification
pre_create_gate: Proceed only if the existing server/controller can capture every required raw field without a new controller lineage and a baseline metric confirms prefill_wall_share >= 0.393755. Otherwise close this arm as telemetry/threshold-not-met; do not infer a saving from synthetic tokens.
acceptance: Measured sustainable endpoint-cost reduction >= 5% after cache lookup, queueing, capacity/replica, and eviction effects; realized cache-hit token fraction and the timing decomposition must independently support the result.
interaction_rule: If MTP, async scheduling, or a higher batch setting changes decode or overlaps prefill, treat it as a new interaction: rerun the matched on/off pair and do not add gains.
failure_closure: A missing raw server metric, cache-hit realization below the level required by 0.05/(prefill_wall_share*net_prefill_recovery_efficiency), eviction-induced capacity loss, or a <=5% measured endpoint result closes the prefix-cache line.
